summary: Verified Family tab expansion + coloring share button, both backend and frontend, per iteration 90 review request. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass in test_iter90_family_share.py covering GET/POST/DELETE /api/family/members (with create->list->delete->verify), companion resolution (companion_name populated from slug), 400 on empty name, adding without a patron, 401/403 unauthenticated, GET /api/companions options, GET /api/coloring-pages (used by share/canvas), GET /api/family/today, and GET /api/library/books/{slug} for all 7 deep-link targets (3 children books + 3 parent guides + humanae-vitae). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, injected sanctus_session_token=test_feat_aug25): family-screen and family-companions section render; Add flow (testID family-member-add -> name input + patron chip + save) creates a member that appears in the list (verified via new testID family-member-{id}); For Children tile family-childbook-bible-stories-for-little-souls navigates to /library/books/bible-stories-for-little-souls; For Parents tile family-guide-humanae-vitae navigates to /library/books/humanae-vitae; coloring canvas /coloring/cross renders and the new testID coloring-share button is present in header and tapping it does not crash the screen (Alert.alert-based informative message on web). Two pre-existing non-blocking react-native-web deprecation warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - the latter also flagged in iteration 89 for the coloring Svg overlay.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web logs 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents='none' from prop to style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/coloring/[slug].tsx:135
react-native-web warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Repeated across app; not caused by this iteration but seen on family/coloring screens.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: silence the pointerEvents/shadow* deprecation warnings surfaced by react-native-web (see react_native_issues).

Optional UX polish: RN Alert.alert-based confirm on web does not auto-render the confirm buttons for the 'Remove family member' flow in a way that Playwright can easily target. Consider adding testIDs to Alert buttons or switching to a custom in-app modal for delete confirmation if you want deterministic e2e delete testing on web preview. Deleting via API works and is verified.
critical_code_review_comments: family.tsx: FamilyCompanions component is well-scoped, uses testIDs on all interactive elements (family-member-add/save/cancel, family-member-name-input, family-patron-{slug}, family-member-{id}, family-member-delete-{id}) - excellent for testing.

family.tsx: On delete, list is optimistically updated then DELETE is fired inside a try/catch - good UX, but a failed DELETE silently keeps the item removed from local state. Consider re-adding on failure (edge case only).
coloring/[slug].tsx: onShare correctly gates behavior with Platform.OS === 'web' and shows Alert; captureRef + expo-sharing.shareAsync used on native. No crash risk on web.
src/api.ts getCompanionOptions gracefully handles both array and {items|companions} shapes from the backend - defensive and correct.
server.py _family_member_public correctly excludes MongoDB _id and resolves companion_name from the COMPANIONS map.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (family CRUD add + deep-links + coloring share button verified; delete via UI dialog not deterministic on web but delete API is verified)

seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_iter90_* / E2E_iter90_* family members were created and cleaned up in the same run (or via curl at the end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Family companions CRUD and library deep-link tiles from Family tab are working end-to-end. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter90_family_share.py is reusable as regression. On web, delete confirmation uses RN Alert.alert which is not deterministic through Playwright; use the DELETE /api/family/members/{id} endpoint directly (verified working) or add explicit testIDs to Alert buttons if UI delete needs to be exercised. Coloring share button testID='coloring-share' - on web it triggers Alert 'Saving pictures / Sanctus app...'.
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature testing only, no bugs found.
